# InLuxe

> > InLuxe offers luxury brand consulting and corporate training services led by David Mardashev, specializing in client experience strategy for high-end retail, hospitality, and banking sectors.

Founded by David Mardashev, InLuxe draws on experience with prestigious brands like Louis Vuitton, Chanel Academy, and Café V in Ginza to deliver tailored consulting for affluent consumer markets. The site also documents privacy policies for the Country Visits Tracker mobile app.
